summary: StratCap Digital Infrastructure REIT filed an 8-K disclosing that its board concluded the strategic alternatives review process initiated earlier in 2026, distributing a stockholder letter dated September 23, 2026. No transaction, price, stake or premium is stated; the board reached a conclusion rather than announcing a sale or merger. The update follows prior 8-Ks filed April 30, 2026 and July 8, 2026, and the letter is posted to the company website with no advisor named. Watch for follow-on disclosure on whether any sale, liquidation or continued-hold path results, since a concluded review with no deal is a negative overhang signal for holders.
